$description: Hand-written. Text sizes, the same in every mode. The first v2 type tokens (2026-10-09, from forms: Bennett asked for a small text size for consistent reuse). Two sizes so far; the full scale comes with the type round.

md.$description: Body text: the default size for reading text, form labels, values and options.

sm.$description: Small text: supporting text such as form descriptions, captions and notes. Regular weight.
